title: %xirr - internal rate of return for dated cash flows
purpose: Find the rate that makes the net present value of dated cash flows zero.
notes: Solved by Newton-Raphson from a default 10% guess; an optional third argument overrides it.
Needs at least two cash flows of equal length with the dates; non-convergent series yield ~.
Output is a TS shortest-round-trip float (last-digit f64 differs cross-language); verified in TS only.
